scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 native ServiceAccounts, Pods, namespaced Roles and RoleBindings, and three case-owned ConfigMaps. Three ordinary synthetic Pods begin with a shared account and are recreated with distinct Training, Inference, and Pipeline accounts. The case reviews named ConfigMap GET authorization using ephemeral authorization.k8s.io/v1 SubjectAccessReviews and does not use workload credentials. A namespace-scoped native admission policy verifies exact type and ServiceAccount mappings. External cloud IAM, federated identities, Kubeflow, KServe, training operators, production resources, and actual model environments are outside this case.
